doc.name: Dravr AI
doc.description: AI-powered fitness data analysis and insights platform providing comprehensive activity analysis, performance tracking, and intelligent recommendations for athletes and fitness enthusiasts. Tool skills are invoked as structured tool calls: a message carries a data part shaped {"tool_name": "<skill id>", "parameters": {...}}. The coaching skill reads a plain text part.

skills.name: Coaching
skills.description: Ask the athlete's coach a question in plain language and get a written answer grounded in their training. Needs a grant the athlete authorized, holding fitness:read and profile:read.
examples: How did my training go this week?
Should I run long tomorrow or take the day off?

skills.name: Get Activities
skills.description: Retrieve user fitness activities from connected providers

skills.name: Analyze Activity
skills.description: AI-powered analysis of a specific fitness activity

skills.name: Set Goal
skills.description: Set a fitness goal for the user

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Dravr-issued OAuth access token in the Authorization header

scopes.fitness:read: Read the athlete's fitness data: activities, stats, sleep, analytics
scopes.fitness:write: Create or modify the athlete's fitness data: goals, plans, logged work
scopes.profile:read: Read the athlete's profile, configuration and linked providers
scopes.profile:write: Change the athlete's profile, configuration and provider links
